title: Create, list and cancel bookings
done: POST /bookings {roomId,startAt,endAt} creates a confirmed booking (201). 404 unknown room, 400 invalid/inverted times, 409 when it overlaps a confirmed booking in the same room (back-to-back is allowed). GET /bookings lists the caller's own. DELETE /bookings/:id cancels (owner or admin; 403 otherwise) and frees the slot.
